modes.name: probe
modes.line: Focus for this turn: learn one thing about the rules with a few cheap moves.

modes.name: rethink
modes.line: Focus for this turn: your current idea of the goal may be wrong. List what you saw and start over.

modes.name: execute
modes.line: Focus for this turn: you know the plan. Carry it out without re-deriving it.

modes.name: brief
modes.line: Focus for this turn: keep thinking short and act.

modes.name: recover
modes.line: Focus for this turn: the last moves ended the run. Say why before moving again.

modes.name: transfer
modes.line: Focus for this turn: this level looks like the last one. Reuse what worked.

modes.name: search
modes.line: Focus for this turn: try moves you have not tried yet.

modes.name: backtrack
modes.line: Focus for this turn: undo to the last good state and take another branch.
